summary: Iteration 22 — retest of the sessionShownRef-based fix for the chat lock-bounce bug. MIXED RESULTS. ✅ PRIMARY scenario (lock-from-inside open chat) IS FIXED — after tapping Confirm in the PIN sheet, PATCH /api/chat/lock/threads returns 200, lock row label flips to 'Chat locked', composer + header + messages REMAIN VISIBLE, and ChatLockGate does NOT appear. This is a genuine win — iter22 solved what iter18/19/20 could not. ❌ HOWEVER — the same fix introduces a CRITICAL REGRESSION in the COLD-GATE flow: when a user cold-navigates / reloads into an already-locked chat (or chat-tab), the gate IS BYPASSED and the locked content renders. Root cause: ChatSettingsProvider initializes `settings=null`, so on the first render isThreadLocked()/isTabLocked() return false (the `!!settings?.has_pin` guard is falsy). ChatThreadScreen's render falls past the gate guard and sets sessionShownRef.current=true at line 236. Microseconds later, settings load with locked_thread_ids=[threadId] / lock_chat_tab=true — but now `alreadyUnlocked = sessionShownRef.current || isUnlocked(threadId)` evaluates to TRUE so the gate is permanently skipped. Net effect: chat-lock is essentially defeated on every fresh page load / app cold-start. SECONDARY tests (carryover from iter20): Block/Unblock confirm-sheet flow IS now working end-to-end (Block Bob → confirm → row flips to 'Unblock Bob' → confirm → flips back). Wallpaper navigation works (navigates to /chat/settings). TouchableOpacity click workaround (JS dispatchEvent) still required on RN-Web for playwright.

ui_bugs.issue: CRITICAL REGRESSION introduced by iter22 fix. On cold mount of a locked thread, settings is null (not yet fetched), isThreadLocked() returns false, chat content renders, and sessionShownRef.current is set to true at line 236. When settings later load with locked_thread_ids=[threadId], the gate guard at line 222 evaluates `locked && !alreadyUnlocked` where alreadyUnlocked=true (due to sessionShownRef), so ChatLockGate is permanently skipped. The locked chat content is visible to the user, defeating the entire chat-lock feature on app cold-start / page reload. Reproduction: with locked_thread_ids=['4f3c...'] persisted on backend, hard-reload /chat/4f3c... — composer + chat history visible, no PIN gate. References: /app/frontend/app/chat/[id].tsx:99 (ref decl), :216 (locked computed before settings loaded), :222 (gate guard), :236 (premature ref flip), /app/frontend/src/chat-settings.tsx:71 (settings init to null), :126 (isThreadLocked returns false when settings null).

CRITICAL REGRESSION — same root cause as ChatThreadScreen. On cold mount of /chat with lock_chat_tab=true, isTabLocked() returns false (settings null), children render, sessionShownRef.current flips to true at line 372. When settings load with lock_chat_tab=true, gate guard at line 362 sees alreadyUnlocked=true and never mounts ChatLockGate. Reproduction: PATCH /api/chat/lock/tab {pin:'1234',lock_chat_tab:true} then hard-reload /chat — chat list (Slang-Connect, Find, threads) is fully visible without PIN. References: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/chat.tsx:358 (ref decl), :360 (isTabLocked called pre-settings), :362 (gate guard), :372 (premature ref flip).

critical_code_review_comments: /app/frontend/app/chat/[id].tsx:216 — `const locked = wpSettings.isThreadLocked(threadId);` is computed in EVERY render, including the first render before settings have loaded. When settings is null, isThreadLocked returns false (see chat-settings.tsx:126 `!!settings?.has_pin && ...`). This is the entry-point of the regression.

/app/frontend/app/chat/[id].tsx:236 — `sessionShownRef.current = true;` is set unconditionally on every render that passes the gate guard. This is the cement-step that locks in the wrong state. Move it inside an `if (settingsLoaded && !locked)` guard.
/app/frontend/app/(tabs)/chat.tsx:372 — same issue. `sessionShownRef.current = true` should only flip after we've confirmed settings are loaded AND tab is currently not locked.

/app/frontend/src/chat-settings.tsx:71 — settings is initialized to null. This is fine architecturally, but every consumer that does early-return-on-locked must explicitly handle the null phase. Consider adding a `loaded: boolean` flag or a Suspense boundary instead of letting null silently mean 'not locked'.

Design note — the iter22 author wrote in a comment on chat/[id].tsx:93-98 that 'cold navigation (component remount) still correctly shows the gate'. The intuition is correct; the implementation isn't, because the first commit on remount happens BEFORE the network fetch completes.

rca_of_issue: REGRESSION RCA (iter22 cold-gate). The iter22 fix introduced `sessionShownRef` in both ChatThreadScreen and ChatTabGate to prevent mid-session lock flips from bouncing the user. The ref is set unconditionally at the bottom of the gate check (chat/[id].tsx:236 and (tabs)/chat.tsx:372). However, ChatSettingsProvider initializes settings to null and fetches them asynchronously; the consumer's isThreadLocked()/isTabLocked() return false when settings is null (chat-settings.tsx:126-132, `!!settings?.has_pin && ...`). Sequence on cold mount of a locked thread: (1) ChatThreadScreen mounts; settings=null. (2) Render #1: locked=false (settings null), alreadyUnlocked=false. Falls past the gate guard; sessionShownRef.current is set to true at line 236. Chat content renders. (3) Settings fetch resolves; ChatSettingsProvider calls setSettings(...). Consumers re-render. (4) Render #2: locked=true (now settings has has_pin+locked_thread_ids), but alreadyUnlocked=true (sessionShownRef is already true). Gate is skipped. Locked content stays visible permanently. Same flow in ChatTabGate. PRIMARY case is not affected because there the user is already past the gate (chat is unlocked) when they tap Lock — so the ref-flip happened legitimately. Fix: require settings non-null before either gating OR setting the ref. See action_items[0] for code.
